formula_model.rule: predict sodium_mg_per_100g = max(0, 393.37 * visible_ash_g_per_100g), using the sodium mass fraction of sodium chloride as a fixed visible-ash proxy; nutrient 307 is excluded from visible inputs and is unsealed only for scoring

comparator_baseline.name: FoodData Central visible calcium mineral baseline
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: predict sodium_mg_per_100g = visible calcium_mg_per_100g from nutrient 301

prediction_materialization.materialization_rule: task rows contain visible-only model and comparator predictions before hidden sodium targets are opened
